name: CubeFlipWords
description: Headline with a static prefix followed by a word that rotates through a list on a true 3D cube flip (rotateX with perspective, the next word on the adjacent face), reserving the widest word's width so the line never jumps.
a11yNotes: Screen readers get a single stable visually hidden sentence listing the prefix and all words, so nothing is announced on every flip; the cube is aria-hidden. Cycling pauses when the element is off-screen or the tab is hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion the first word is shown statically with no cycling.

propsApi.description: Static text shown before the rotating word.

propsApi.description: Duration of each flip in seconds.
